customerId.description: The ID of the Customer to which this PaymentMethod is saved.

paymentGatewayId.description: The ID of the PaymentGateway through which this PaymentMethod is processed.

externalId.description: The ID of the PaymentMethod as registered in the external PaymentGateway system. Used to reference the method in operations with the provider.

holderEmail.description: Email address associated with the PaymentMethod holder. This may differ from the Customer's email.

holderName.description: Full name of the individual or entity that owns the PaymentMethod. This may differ from the Customer's registered name.

creditCard.description: If this is a card PaymentMethod, this contains the user’s card details.

expiration.description: The card's expiration date, typically in MM/YY format.

expirationMonth.description: Two-digit number representing the card’s expiration month.

expirationYear.description: Four-digit number representing the card’s expiration year.

product.description: The card product type (e.g., "Visa Classic", "Mastercard Gold").

creditCard.title: CreditCardInfo

directDebit.description: If this is a sepa_debit PaymentMethod, this contains the user’s card details.
directDebit.title: DirectDebitInfo

additionalInformation1.description: Additional information field 1 for the payment method. Can be used to store custom data specific to the payment gateway.

additionalInformation2.description: Additional information field 2 for the payment method. Can be used to store custom data specific to the payment gateway.

additionalInformation3.description: Additional information field 3 for the payment method. Can be used to store custom data specific to the payment gateway.
